# GOST desktop integration

The bundled `components/gost.exe` is a custom **3.3.3-desktop.1** build of the
pinned GOST v3.3.3 source. It uses the adjacent `gost-x` source through a local
module replacement. That library has two bounded patches: verified encrypted
DNS defaults/default ports, and correct HTTP hop-header removal. Full diffs
and regression tests are included. It is not an unchanged official binary.

Source tag: `v3.3.3`
Source commit: `3d514c57230bfa524aa89087da5580b314f1cd36`
Release: https://github.com/go-gost/gost/releases/tag/v3.3.3
Runtime library: `github.com/go-gost/x v0.28.1`, commit
`006b432a7d0472d49ec3ca77a37a133c71e8c0f3`.

`go.mod` and `go.sum` lock the dependencies. The only change in this main source
is the local replacement documented in `DESKTOP_PATCH.diff`; runtime corrections
are fully documented under `../gost-x`.

The original official release archive was downloaded and verified against
GitHub release metadata and its checksum file before the source build:

```text
gost_3.3.3_windows_amd64.zip
SHA256 b00441624a66ebed94a2ddcc01ab2832069f053e6ca0abf19d7104b84fad1f78
```

The distributed custom executable, built with Go 1.26.11, Windows/amd64,
baseline v1, CGO disabled:

```text
SHA256 3b7d5a1f3a4e0d072ffef630d49cfa8c049b3997bb20ff92118a42bb1f622525
```

## Runtime

The controller starts the child process without a console window and supplies
JSON configuration through stdin using GOST's existing support:

```text
components\gost.exe -C -
```

The configuration is generated by the desktop application; no default user
password is distributed. Control API, profiling, remote plugins, debug and
trace logging are not enabled. Child `GOST_*` environment overrides are
removed by the controller so inherited environment variables cannot turn on
unintended endpoints or secret-bearing debug configuration logs.

## Rebuild on Windows

Use Go 1.26.11 or a compatible later version. The ready executable does not
require Go. The root `Rebuild-Components.cmd` rebuilds all three Go components.
To rebuild GOST alone from this directory:

```bat
set GOTOOLCHAIN=local
set GOWORK=off
set CGO_ENABLED=0
set GOOS=windows
set GOARCH=amd64
set GOAMD64=v1
go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags="-s -w -X main.version=3.3.3-desktop.1" -o ..\..\components\gost.exe ./cmd/gost
```

Go downloads the pinned modules and verifies them using `go.sum`. Compiler
binaries and caches are not included. Rebuilding with another toolchain or
flags can produce a different executable hash.
